Join Us
Cardinal Pole Catholic School is a mixed comprehensive school for 11-19 year old students
Our school is built on strong foundations of discipline and moral purpose. We offer a lively, dynamic and highly successful environment in which to achieve. Above all, we are a faith community, providing an enriching education which cares deeply about the wellbeing and development of our children and our community.

Why Choose Us
Results
Our GCSE grades reflect a strong tradition of success and progress last year, putting Cardinal Pole in the top 25% of schools nationally. There were very strong performances in many subjects, notably English, Music, Art, 3D Design and RE and Sociology, where students excelled. Our commitment to a rigorous and broad curriculum was demonstrated in the fact that nearly three quarters of all students were entered for EBACC this year (the study of one of the humanities and a language in addition to core); significantly more than nationally.
Extra Curricular
We encourage all our students to enrich their learning with extra-curricular activities. We currently offer: Athletics, Badminton, Basketball, Bible Club, Boxing, Breakfast Club, Chess Club, Choir, Debate Team, Duke of Edinburgh, Fitness, Football, Homework Club, House Drama, Judo, Maths Club, Music Lessons, Netball, Rugby, Sixth Form Study, Spoken Word, STEM Group (Science), Table Tennis and Trampoline.
Catholic Life
Cardinal Pole Catholic School welcomes all families who support our values. Our school is rooted in Catholic values which permeate all aspects of work and relationships. Our Chapel is at the heart of the school, placing Christ at the centre of everything that we do. Cardinal Pole Catholic School is a community of service guiding young people on a path to opportunity, aspiration and reward, founded on Catholic values.
Literacy
At Cardinal Pole School, Literacy is at the heart of everything we do. We therefore offer students a wide range of stimulating ways to develop their ability to speak, read and write effectively. From a well-stocked Library to a range of high-quality interventions and our very own School Poet, we strive to help our students to gain Literacy skills that will enable them to thrive throughout their lives.

Mia-Rose

But at Cardinal Pole our Sixth Form Team and careers advisor gives us endless opportunities to apply our strengths and interests through taster sessions and work experience with a range of companies. We also get lots of support and advice when it comes to applying for universities or apprenticeships. It’s essential to have lots of options available to you and Cardinal Pole has easily given me that reassurance!”

Chaplaincy
Chaplaincy is a central and integral part of the life and work of Cardinal Pole; a place where young people can grow in faith and in belonging to the school community. Its purpose is to support the spiritual development of students and staff and to offer pastoral support as part of the wider staff team. This encourages discipleship amongst our students which helps and inspires them to live out our school principles of Service, Opportunity, Aspiration and Reward with Christ at the centre of everything we do.

An Outstanding Catholic School
Mission and Values
Cardinal Pole School is a Catholic community with a long history of success, with state-of-the-art facilities. It is a well-established mixed 11-19 comprehensive school with a wealth of achievements and experience. Cardinal Pole Catholic School is described by Ofsted 2017 as a 'Good school with Outstanding 6th Form'. The Diocese of Westminster in their recent inspection not only graded the school as ‘Outstanding’ in every category, the report commented that our ‘distinctive inclusive ethos of this school is tangible in every area of school life from classroom to corridors and in relationships between students and staff’ and described progress as outstanding. Importantly, it described the school as a ‘safe place that allows all to flourish’ and a place where ‘Students make outstanding progress’. Post 16 results are consistently graded 'Outstanding' and results at GCSE compare well against nationals and students make excellent progress. We are especially proud of the successful progression secured by our students as the move to higher education and employment; examples of this include our current Chair of Governors Justin Madubuko, Business Development Manager at Barclays, Oscar Murillo, Turner Prize Winner and Bukky Bakray BAFTA Winner.
A real strength of the school is the combination of academic success underpinned by a shared ethos based on Catholic Christian values and an emphasis on nurturing positive relationships for which they were praised in the recent Ofsted and greatly valued by our parents and school community. The school upholds core principles of Service, Opportunity, Aspiration and Reward. We aim to provide a dynamic and inclusive educational experience that encourages independent and confident learners. We know that success comes through hard work and we constantly strive for this in partnership with the children and their families so that all children make excellent progress.
The school is led by highly qualified and dedicated professionals who are committed to the success of all.
School Vision
Cardinal Pole Catholic School is an educating community for all based on partnership and respect. It is a strong and vibrant place which recognises the importance and individual needs of every pupil and member of staff. Our well-being and PSHE programme is outstanding.
Praise and encouragement are vital in creating a climate of learning and high expectations, supported by teaching of the highest quality.
The school is full of confident, creative and fulfilled young people and staff. They are celebrated as individuals – unique creations of God – who deserve our support, love and trust as they begin the great journey of life.
We look forward to meeting you.
Mr Adam Hall, BA (Hons) MA NPQH
Executive Headteacher

Collective Worship
Weekly Mass for Students
Every week, on year group rotation, students attend the celebration of Mass. Students are eager to participate as altar servers and readers. Additionally, every week we have an optional Mass open to both students and staff.
Every week, students from the selected year group write bidding prayers for their year group Mass.
Every year, the new Year 7 cohort are received into the spiritual life of the school by celebrating a Welcome Mass in which parents were invited. All students receive a bible that is blessed during the Mass.
To mark the end our students’ journey at Cardinal Pole we celebrate a thanksgiving Mass. Holy Days of Obligation are celebrated across the entire school and all pupils and staff are given the morning off to attend Mass at a local parish.
Cardinal Reginald Pole Requiem Mass
Each Year Mass is offered for the rest of the soul of our school's namesake, Cardinal Reginald Pole.

School Mission
An Outstanding Catholic School
Mission and Values
Cardinal Pole School is a Catholic community with a long history of success, with state-of-the-art facilities. It is a well-established mixed 11-19 comprehensive school with a wealth of achievements and experience. Cardinal Pole Catholic School is described by Ofsted 2017 as a 'Good school with Outstanding 6th Form'. The Diocese of Westminster in their recent inspection not only graded the school as ‘Outstanding’ in every category, the report commented that our ‘distinctive inclusive ethos of this school is tangible in every area of school life from classroom to corridors and in relationships between students and staff’ and described progress as outstanding. Importantly, it described the school as a ‘safe place that allows all to flourish’ and a place where ‘Students make outstanding progress’. Post 16 results are consistently graded 'Outstanding' and results at GCSE compare well against nationals and students make excellent progress. We are especially proud of the successful progression secured by our students as the move to higher education and employment; examples of this include our current Chair of Governors Justin Madubuko, Business Development Manager at Barclays, Oscar Murillo, Turner Prize Winner and Bukky Bakray BAFTA Winner.
A real strength of the school is the combination of academic success underpinned by a shared ethos based on Catholic Christian values and an emphasis on nurturing positive relationships for which they were praised in the recent Ofsted and greatly valued by our parents and school community. The school upholds core principles of Service, Opportunity, Aspiration and Reward. We aim to provide a dynamic and inclusive educational experience that encourages independent and confident learners. We know that success comes through hard work and we constantly strive for this in partnership with the children and their families so that all children make excellent progress.
The school is led by highly qualified and dedicated professionals who are committed to the success of all.
School Vision
Cardinal Pole Catholic School is an educating community for all based on partnership and respect. It is a strong and vibrant place which recognises the importance and individual needs of every pupil and member of staff. Our well-being and PSHE programme is outstanding.
Praise and encouragement are vital in creating a climate of learning and high expectations, supported by teaching of the highest quality.
The school is full of confident, creative and fulfilled young people and staff. They are celebrated as individuals – unique creations of God – who deserve our support, love and trust as they begin the great journey of life.
We look forward to meeting you.
Mr Adam Hall, BA (Hons) MA NPQH

At Cardinal Pole Sixth Form, we are proud to offer an outstanding post-16 education where academic ambition, personal growth, and community spirit thrive together. Built on the school’s strong Catholic values of Service, Opportunity, Aspiration and Reward, our Sixth Form nurtures confident, curious and compassionate young adults ready to succeed in an ever-changing world.
Our Sixth Form delivers strong academic results. We consistently place among the top performing Sixth Forms nationally. Many of our graduates go on to study at highly regarded universities, including Oxford, Cambridge, King’s College London, UCL, and the University of Warwick, as well as to pursue competitive apprenticeships and careers. Our dedicated teachers provide tailored support, expert guidance and a culture of academic excellence, ensuring each student is well-prepared for their next steps — whether that’s higher education, employment or training.
Life at Cardinal Pole Sixth Form is about so much more than grades. We champion a rich and diverse extracurricular programme that empowers students to explore new interests, build leadership skills, and forge lifelong friendships. Our Sixth Formers are encouraged to develop their passions, contribute to school life, and make a positive impact locally and beyond — shaping the kind of well-rounded, resilient young adults that universities and employers value most.
Cardinal Pole Sixth Form offers a caring, inclusive environment where every student is known and supported. Our dedicated pastoral team and personalised careers guidance help students navigate the complexities of post-16 life with confidence and clarity. Most importantly, our Sixth Formers receive the respect, individual attention and care that all students can expect at Cardinal Pole Catholic School.

Guest Speakers
Guest Speakers
Throughout the year we welcome various external chaplaincy speakers to come and meet our students enchanting our rich spiritual life.
Jenny Garzón Saavedra from the Colombian Amazon
Jenny Garzón Saavedra and Susan Kambalu and spoke to a group of Year 13 and 7 students about their work in the Amazon that helps communities learn to care for creation. This includes ways of putting this into practice in all areas of day-to-day lives. For example, communities find innovative ways to recycle discarded household objects into useful items.
Will Hince, the founder of a Catholic charity ‘Beyond the Wild’ spoke to Y7 and Y8 about faith, particularly from the point of his experience as a survivalist and explorer.
In October Fr Valentine visited Cardinal Pole to meet our all our Y9 and Y12 students and talk about his experience as a Chaplain in a youth offenders' prison. He left our students with an important message: It is never too late to turn your life around seek the Lord.
Bakhita House came in to talk to students about the work they do with victims of human trafficking, as well as how the pandemic affected their work.
Westminster Youth Ministry
Holly Cook from the Diocese of Westminster came in to talk to our year 12 students about the work that the Church does in promoting stewardship, as well as some of the supporting theology, informed by Pope Fancis’ Laudato Si.
CHIPS Peace a Christian charity, came in to talk with students about their work both nationally and abroad in bridging gaps between feuding gangs; and even open, armed conflict.
Daughters of Divine Charity
Sr Anna and Linda visited in June and gave a talk on the importance of prayer to all of Y7 and Y9 and taught them a song. Later in the day had a dance off with our students in the playground!

RSE/PSHE
Relationships, Sex and Health Education (RSE) and Personal, Social, Health and Economic Education (PSHE)
At Cardinal Pole Catholic School, we are committed to educating the whole person and helping every student flourish spiritually, academically, socially and emotionally. Our RSE/PSHE curriculum plays a vital role in this mission by equipping young people with the knowledge, skills and values they need to lead safe, healthy and fulfilling lives.
Rooted in our Catholic ethos and inspired by our mission values of service, opportunity, aspiration and reward, our RSE/PSHE programme promotes respect, compassion, integrity, accountability, equality, empathy and high expectations. Through age-appropriate learning, students develop the confidence to build healthy relationships, make informed decisions, care for their physical and mental wellbeing, understand their responsibilities as citizens, and prepare for life beyond school.
RSE/PSHE and British Values are delivered through two dedicated form-time sessions each week, ensuring a consistent and progressive curriculum for every year group. Our provision is enhanced through the Ten Ten Life to the Full programme and a range of external visitors and specialists, enabling students to engage with important topics through both faith-informed teaching and real-world perspectives.
Statutory Compliance
Cardinal Pole Catholic School delivers a comprehensive RSE/PSHE curriculum that meets the requirements of the Department for Education's statutory guidance on Relationships, Sex and Health Education. As a secondary academy, we provide RSE to all pupils in accordance with the Children and Social Work Act 2017 and have regard to relevant legislation including the Education Act 1996 and the Equality Act 2010.
Our curriculum has been designed to support the implementation of the updated statutory guidance from September 2026 and ensures that all students receive accurate, age-appropriate and evidence-informed learning about relationships, health, safety, wellbeing and personal development.
Inclusivity Commitment
We believe that every student should have access to high-quality RSE/PSHE education. Teaching is carefully adapted to meet the diverse needs, abilities, levels of maturity and personal circumstances of our students. The curriculum promotes respect for all individuals and actively challenges discrimination, prejudice, bullying and harmful behaviours.
Students with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) receive appropriately adapted teaching, resources and support to ensure they can fully participate in learning and develop the knowledge, understanding and skills appropriate to their individual needs.
